description:
## CHANGELOG roll-up + workspace-level release notes for 1.0

Autonomous-execution bead. Blocks on .6 (Limitations audit complete) and any in-flight implementation work that lands before 1.0 publish.

For each 1.0-included crate, produce or update its `CHANGELOG.md` to mark the 1.0.0 release. Plus a workspace-level release notes document for the 1.0 announcement.

## Per-crate CHANGELOG entries

For each of the 11 crates (scope per .1):

- [ ] `## 1.0.0 - YYYY-MM-DD` heading at top
- [ ] Summary line: "First stable release."
- [ ] If 0.x → 1.0 has breaking changes: enumerate them under `### Breaking`
- [ ] If 0.x → 1.0 has new features since last 0.x: enumerate under `### Added`
- [ ] If 0.x → 1.0 fixed bugs since last 0.x: enumerate under `### Fixed`
- [ ] Link to relevant beads where useful (don't over-link; CHANGELOG is user-facing)

## Workspace-level release notes

Single document, location TBD (top-level `RELEASE_NOTES.md` or similar). Contains:

- Summary: "RFC 5280 X.509 for Rust, done right from the start. 11 crates shipping at 1.0; adjacent ecosystem continues at independent 0.x cadence."
- What's included (the 11 crates, one-line each)
- What's not included (AIA online fetching, AC, CT, DANE, composite, platform trust stores, comprehensive CA/B Forum policy adapter — all available as 0.x sibling crates with independent roadmaps)
- Quick start example (verify_tls_server hostname binding shown)
- Stability promise (1.0 = semver stability; future breaking changes require major bump)
- Acknowledgments (RustCrypto upstream, NIST PKITS, pyca/cryptography, OpenSSL, etc. as appropriate)

## Execution

Autonomous loop generates initial drafts from bead-tracked changes + git log. Mark reviews and refines wording before publish.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each 1.0-included crate's CHANGELOG.md has a 1.0.0 entry
- [ ] Workspace-level release notes drafted
- [ ] Mark reviewed both
- [ ] All references (beads, crates, RFCs) are accurate

## Cross-references

- PKIX-wlsr (parent)
- PKIX-wlsr.6 (Limitations audit; CHANGELOG sometimes points at Limitations sections)
- All beads closing as part of 1.0 cascade (CHANGELOG enumerates the user-visible effects)
notes: [2026-05-13 gating documented] Wired 4 task-shape dep blockers (PKIX-zkjb.2/.3/.4/.9). PKIX-lwr9.4 is an epic so direct dep is disallowed by beads (tasks can only depend on tasks); it's tracked informally as a 1.0-blocker label and PKIX-wlsr.7 should not be drafted until that epic closes too. When all 5 1.0-blockers land, .7 surfaces and the CHANGELOG roll-up can be drafted against the final 1.0 state.
title: CHANGELOG roll-up + workspace-level release notes for 1.0 (autonomous)
